claims.text: Topical ruxolitinib (JAK1/2) is available for vitiligo; depigmentation can recur after it is stopped
claims.quote: The topical Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitor ruxolitinib (JAK 1 and 2) is available for the treatment of vitiligo (5). Another JAK inhibitor, tofacitinib (JAK 1 and 3), is currently under investigation. However, depigmentation can recur after these agents are stopped.
